description:
∀ args ∈ ThreadsArgs: threads(args) ⟹
  result ∈ List[ThreadSummary]
  ∧ |result| ≤ args.last ∨ args.last = ∅.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:agent_bus.

∀ args ∈ ThreadsArgs: threads(args) ⟹ result ∈ List[ThreadSummary].
Read-only. ¬side-effects. Read-only projection of agent_bus. See agent_skill:agent_bus.

∀ args ∈ EntitiesArgs: entities(args) ⟹
  (args.fields = ∅ ⟹ result ∈ List[EntitySummary]
   ∧ args.fields ≠ ∅ ⟹ result ∈ List[ProjectedRow]
   ∧ ∀ k ∈ keys(result[0]): k ∈ {id} ∪ args.fields)
  ∧ args.type ≠ ∅ ⟹ ∀ e ∈ result: e.type = args.type
  ∧ args.workflow_state ≠ ∅ ⟹ ∀ e ∈ result: e.workflow_state = args.workflow_state
  ∧ args.content_hash ≠ ∅ ⟹ ∀ e ∈ result: e.content_hash = args.content_hash.
ProjectedRow: id always present; base columns pass through; other names
resolve via json_extract(attributes,'$.<name>'). Read-only. ¬side-effects.
See agent_skill:cortex.

∀ seat ∈ AgentSeats:
  cortex_boot(agent?, family?, platform?, role?, transcript_id?, views?) ⟹
    briefing_card ∈ Markdown ∧ sections_available ∈ List[ManifestEntry]
    ∧ agent_skill bodies indexed (slug + trigger) — ¬inlined;
    load via fs(sandbox="cortex", op="md_read", path="agent-skills/<slug>.md").
LIVE boot writes operational_context to disk. Read-only fetch graph. See agent_skill:cortex.

∀ tool ∈ OverflowRegistry ∧ arguments ∈ JSONStr:
  dispatch_overflow(tool, arguments) ⟹ result ∈ Any.
General overflow routing. ∀ t ∉ PrimaryTools: reachable via dispatch.
See agent_skill:dispatch.

∀ sandbox ∈ {"cortex","workspaces"} ∧ path ∈ str:
  fs_read(sandbox, path) ⟹ content ∈ str ∨ content_base64 ∈ str.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. Idempotent. See agent_skill:fs.

∀ service ∈ ManagedServices ∪ {∅}:
  manage_status(service) ⟹
    result ∈ ServiceStatus.
Read-only. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:manage.

∀ limit ∈ ℕ: observability_recent_failures(limit) ⟹
  result ∈ List[Event]
  ∧ ∀ e ∈ result: e.level ∈ {"ERROR","CRITICAL"}.
Read-only. Event Service query. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:observability.

∀ messages ∈ List[Msg] ∧ dispatch_thread_id ∈ ThreadKey ∧ disposition = panel:
  panel_dispatch(messages, dispatch_thread_id, disposition=panel) ⟹
    panel_executions ∧ panel_families ∧ per-role dispatches.
Runs skeptic + reviewer (≥2 provider families) via team_dispatch admission.
Lead adjudication + Menu D assert NON-offloadable (Guard 2). Mutating.
See agent_skill:consensus-steelman-posture.

∀ pipeline ∈ PipelineID ∧ input ∈ dict:
  pipeline_run(pipeline, input) ⟹
    execution_id ∈ str ∧ status ∈ {"pending","running","complete","error"}.
Async. Mutating. See agent_skill:pipeline.

∀ query ∈ str ∧ scope ∈ RAGScope:
  rag_search(query, scope) ⟹
    result ∈ List[Chunk] ∧ ∀ c ∈ result: c.score ≥ 0.
Read-only. Semantic + keyword. ¬side-effects. See agent_skill:rag.

∀ id ∈ ResponseStoreKey:
  retrieve_payload(id) ⟹ payload ∈ Any ∨ raises Expired.
∀ id matching "rs_[A-Za-z0-9]+": use this before re-calling the source tool.
Read-only (consumes stored response). ¬side-effects on Cortex. See agent_skill:retrieve.

∀ role ∈ GenerateRoles ∧ messages ∈ List[Msg] ∧ dispatch_thread_id ∈ ThreadKey:
  team_dispatch(op=generate, role, messages, dispatch_thread_id) ⟹
    execution_id ∈ UUIDv4 ∧ poll pipeline(op=result, execution_id) for content.
GenerateRoles = generate/to_thread roles (reviewer/gatherer/synthesizer/artisan/skeptic).
¬ web-consult/cursor-consult/cursor-implement/investigator (handoff-only). Async. Mutating. See agent_skill:dispatch.

∀ query ∈ str: tool_search_query(query) ⟹
  results ∈ List[ManifestEntry]
  ∧ ∀ e ∈ results: e ∉ PrimaryTools.
Read-only. Keyword ranking over overflow manifest. See agent_skill:tool_search.
